verdict.rationale: Extensive first-party docs describe grouping production traces into datasets (docs-10, docs-25, docs-41, docs-65), attaching evaluators to datasets/experiments to score outputs (docs-18, docs-26, docs-55, docs-61), and comparing evaluation results across app versions to confirm improvements (docs-41, docs-66). GitHub also confirms versioned datasets for experiments (gh-1). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party validation of the dataset+offline-eval workflow beyond vendor docs.
